identifier_namespace: Audit-local: D01 and D02 are not the repository register rows of those names.
baseline: Maintained mapping of 18 reports and 123 finding entries, plus selected original ledgers.

findings.title: Advertised backend defaults are ignored
findings.evidence: Source-established default branch; independent contract model; public native prediction unrun.
findings.increment: Identifies a specific post-review hard-coded default branch with an order-retention consequence.
findings.candidate: Resolve the canonical constructor default through OptionValue when an explicit selector is absent.
findings.limits: Does not establish an independently mutable default policy for AsymptoticExpand.

findings.title: Nested Function syntax is treated as a callable-source contract
findings.evidence: Source-established recursive predicate; pure-redex and nonreal Root public probes supplied, unrun; quartic positivity checked independently.
findings.increment: Distinguishes the role of the whole source from Function nodes inside an applied expression or Root encoding.
findings.candidate: Test root callable role for Function while retaining recursive protection of other branch-bearing objects.
findings.limits: No claim that arbitrary source programs can be reordered while preserving side effects.

findings.title: Held option classification uses structural rather than option-name identity
findings.evidence: Source inspection plus official OptionValue symbol/string/context contract; independent key model; native candidates unrun.
prior_relation: D01/D06 general option and UX consistency
findings.increment: Concrete pre-OptionValue classification mismatch across selector, stripping, specification and resource-option handling.
findings.candidate: Shared non-evaluating held key-name normalization and canonical declared key selection.
findings.limits: Does not solve every ambiguity between expansion specifications and option rules.

findings.title: Observable native Taylor import does not enforce the returned endpoint
findings.evidence: Mathematical counterexample with h(t)=1+t+t^2 and truthful short Taylor data; independent conversion model; native provider and public route unrun.
findings.increment: False O(x^4) can result even when a true O(t^2) Taylor bound and an analytic polynomial are assumed; identifies a guard already present in the neighboring forward path.
findings.candidate: Fail closed before accessing coefficients if the returned native endpoint does not exceed the requested Taylor order.
findings.limits: No stock built-in short-provider witness was obtained; this is not a complete analyticity-admission repair.

findings.title: Exact derived refinement replays a precision-capped ancestor unnecessarily
findings.evidence: Source trace; proof that a constant observable requires zero ancestor information; independent demand model; native public regression unrun.
findings.increment: Concrete exact constant availability failure beyond an uncertain inverse cap, contrasted with the existing inverse-only exact fast path.
findings.candidate: Validate then return an ordinary exact derived value unchanged mathematically when all retained blocks fit the request, updating cutoff/statistics.
findings.limits: No measured native speedup; no change to coarsening that discards retained blocks or to nonordinary/native result contracts.

findings.title: Current README contradicts implemented automatic routing
findings.evidence: Direct comparison of source and current documentation.
findings.increment: Specific stale paragraph still equates Automatic and Package despite implemented routing.
findings.candidate: Replace that paragraph with the current routing distinctions and scoped historical-validation wording.
findings.limits: Not a general proposal to rewrite all documentation.
